article:
Carrom Club GAME



                    Carrom Club : A Disc Pool Carrom Board Multiplayer For Android
Carrom is a popular social game in India, enjoyed by people of all ages. In India, the game is played in public, in a circle of players. The objective is to reach a score before the opponent.

You can now enjoy playing this game on your Android device with Carrom Club. The app enables you to play whether you are offline or online. It is great for competitive players as it features various types of multiplayer modes. Hence, you can connect with other players in online matches. If you don't have an internet connection, you can play against the expert bot and improve your skills and gameplay.

Carrom Club will give you the feel of playing on a real Carrom Board on your android phone or android tablet.

The game of Carrom is believed to have originated from the Indian subcontinent. The objective of play is to use a striker disk with a flick of the finger to make contact with and move lighter object disks called carrom men, which are thus propelled into one of four corner pockets. Lets pick the striker and become the King or Queen of the Carrom Club board game.

The aim of the game is to pot (or pocket) one's nine carrom men (either Black or White) and the Queen (Red) before your opponent. Carrom follows similar "strike and pocket" games, like pool, shuffleboard, billiards, snooker etc. with its use of rebounds, angles and obstruction of opponent's pieces. 
Carrom is also known as karrom, karom, carom, carrum in various parts of the world.

Challenges – Play Carrom Board unlimited in offline mode with more than 1000 levels. Unlock the cool and challenging stages while playing. Practice to be the best.

Online Multiplayer Game Modes – Play Carrom Board live against real opponents anytime, anywhere in exciting online multiplayer modes

Local Multiplayer Game Modes – Play Carrom Board live with your family and friends on your mobile in offline mode also.

Play Using Code – Take down real players anytime, anywhere in a thrilling Carrom match. (Coming soon)

Play with Friends – Invite, Challenge & Compete with your friends, Win the carrom challenges/matches and climb the leader-board.

Play Nearby – Beat the other nearby real players to be the king of Carrom Board Game.

Featuring two amazing multiplayer game types – 'Freestyle' and 'Black & White'.

Play the Carrom with an automatic machine , if you are alone or Play the two Player/Dual match when you are with your friends.

Carrom Club gives you different game modes (Practice, One Player, Two Player, Arcade, Dual and Contest), ironically you can also play a 2d carrom in this 3d game …..!!

For those who don't know the carrom game, it is a strike and pocket game similar to billiards, or pools. In Carrom (also known as karrom or carom) the players have to strike and pocket the carrom men (coins) using a striker of their choice, and the first one to do so with the maximum number of carrom men wins the game. A single red coin known as the queen has to be pocketed and followed by another carrom men, if not it will be returned to the center. In case of a draw, the user who pockets the queen wins the match.

Carrom Club simulates the physics of the carrom accurately. You can try out any zig-zag shots you used to play on a carrom board.
With realistic 3D simulation and intuitive touch control, you’re sure to be hooked onto the action for hours.
If you like challenges ,try the Arcade mode and collect more and more candies to unlock more challenge levels.

We hope you will enjoy our Carrom Club, as you would on a real Carrom Board. 
We appreciate your reviews to improve Carrom Club with new features.

article:
Caucasus Parking GAME



                    Mobile game - Caucasus Parking.

- In order to make a fuss on the warm southern streets, it is not necessary to have an expensive and powerful car, it is enough just to have a phone.

The meaning of the game is that you appear in a random place on the map, you must find a parking space, which is marked with a green marker, then you must park your car with the front wheels.

A beautiful and high-quality 3d parking simulator in which you can upgrade your driving skills.

There is car tuning, you can customize your car as you want! Choose the type of car with which you will pass the levels, you can make both a bright car and a strict “oper-style” style.

 More than 20 cars are presented in the parking simulator! From the most popular models LADA, BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Nissan to rare cars such as Buggati and Aston Martin.

Also in the game there is an investigative committee machine! You can feel like a real detective!

Realistic car physics will add a pleasant pastime in this 3d parking simulator! Drive your favorite cars through the narrow streets of the Caucasus and improve your driving skills. Every resident of the south should be able to drive a car!

The game features 104 levels, go through them all and become a real "vanity", because only true racers are awarded this title.

All actions of the game take place in Russia! A lot of Russian cars! Tune and drive Russian cars!

If you like 3D parking games, car driving games, car parking games and are looking for an amazing parking simulator game, this game is for you. Become a parking king by showing your friends your level and become a parking master!

Playing in Caucasus Parking (Parking Caucasus), you learn to manage your iron horse more and more well.

The creator of this game was inspired by the nature and streets of Russia, Dagestan, Chechnya, Armenia, Georgia, as well as other regions! I also took examples of houses from such popular cities as Krasnodar, Makhachkala, Derbent, Grozny, Sochi and so on!
